push.title: W 3-2 vs NorthStar | You: 9.2
push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 9.2 against NorthStar. You were a problem for them all night, the good kind.

THE GOOD
+ 4 shots at NorthStar's goal. Can't score 'em if you don't take 'em.
+ Man of the Match, your 14th for us. That's a performance people follow.
+ Tackle success 40%, up from your usual 12%. Gold star, no notes.
+ Top-rated Grizzly in the match. Your teammates felt that, even if the scoreboard didn't.
+ Better key passes than any of their humans (1 vs their best 0). You earned that one the honest way.

THE BAD
- Key passes 1, down from your usual 3. From the clipboard: Switch play when they shift across. Quickest way to find space is usually on the far side.
- Lowest pass accuracy on the team: 77% (best was BellyTb1's 83%). A little secret: Scan before the ball gets to you - a quick shoulder check means you already know the pass before you need it.
- Most missed tackles on the team: 3 (best was buddskees's 1). Honest truth: that cost us.

Repetition station: Look forward first. Check the striker's run and the gap between the lines before the sideways pass.

One thought for the road, PhogsToffees: A good teammate is like a good umbrella. You don't notice 'em till it rains.

Keep writing those happy chapters. - Coach Lasso

push.body:
buddskees, an 8.4. Not flashy, just useful, and useful wins matches.

THE GOOD
+ 29 passes (up from your usual 21). The ball kept finding you, and that's no coincidence.
+ 2 key passes. You found gaps I didn't know were there, and I was looking.
+ You and PhogsToffees were like salt and pepper tonight. Better together.
+ 7th straight match at 7.5 match rating. If the rest of the night was a storm, that was the lighthouse.
+ A promotion match, and we won it. Put that in the team scrapbook.

- Only 2 tackles attempted. Back to basics: When we lose it, press for 3-5 seconds right away. That's when they're most disorganized. Easy as pie.
- Shot accuracy 0%, down from your usual 60%. Next rep: Look up before you shoot. Half a second tells you where the keeper's weight is.
- 2 goals conceded: -0.1. A little care goes a long way.
- Pass accuracy: 79%. Halfway up the mountain. The view from 87%+ is something else.
- Match rating 8.4, from 10.0 in your previous match. Let's turn that around by next session.

Five minutes of this: Make yourself big in the box when they shoot. Blocks count, even if the stats don't.

Listen here, buddskees: Quiet feet, loud heart.

Hard days make strong players. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 3-2 vs NorthStar | You: 6.4
push.body:
A 6.4, BellyTb1. Rough patch. But you know what grows in rough patches? Wildflowers.

THE GOOD
+ Misplaced passes 2, down from your usual 5. That's growth you can count.
+ Better shots on target than any of their humans (3 vs their best 1). You can build a whole match on that.
+ A promotion match, and we won it. That one belongs to all of us, and you were in it.
+ 1 tackle won: +0.2. The little extras matter.

THE BAD
- Only 12 passes (down from your usual 21). Repeat after me: Drift into the half-space between their midfield and defense. It's the hardest spot to mark.
- 0 goals from 3 on target. Let's try: Timed finishing only when you trust it. A clean shot to the corner beats a mistimed rocket. That's a promise.
- Key passes 0, down from your usual 1. My two cents: Arrive late at the edge of the box for cutbacks. That's where midfield chances come from.
- 2 missed tackles: -0.1. Let's polish that.
- 2 goals conceded took 0.1. Clean that up next time.

THE UGLY
! Match rating 6.4, down from your usual 8.2. That one hurt the team, and the team deserves better.

Back-garden drill: Check away, then check back. A two-yard feint buys you the space to receive.

BellyTb1, take this with you: The ball doesn't know your rating. Neither should your attitude.

Champions have off days too. - Coach Lasso
